node.title: Re: use 5.32
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As per [doc://use], any use VERSION where VERSION is 5.12 or higher enables [doc://strict], as well as the corresponding [doc://feature#FEATURE-BUNDLES|feature bundle]. I would recommend also enabling [doc://warnings] (see [id://111088]), i.e.

#!/usr/bin/env perl use warnings; use 5.032; # or use v5.32

The above shebang uses the perl that's in your PATH, for a specific perl, use e.g. #!/usr/bin/perl.
